# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c19 P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Titles:** class beauty and belle  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Phil has brown tints to her coloring that are complemented by yellow silk dresses. At her wedding, she made a dainty, fairy-like bride.

_Sources: [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Phil is sweet, goodhearted, and poised, possessing a charm that makes her easily liked by others. Though she projects an exterior of frivolity and indecisiveness, she conceals a deeply loyal soul underneath. She is naturally friendly and social, viewing young men as good comrades and playfellows rather than purely romantic interests. She remains crystal-free of snobbishness and freely shares her social circle with her friends.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031)_

## History

Phil met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant during her freshman year at Redmond College, quickly drawing them into her vast social circle and helping them acclimate to Kingsport. For a long time, she was indecisive between two suitors from home, Alec and Alonzo, treating them both as playful chums. During her sophomore year, she moved into Patty's Place with Anne, Priscilla, Stella Maynard, and Aunt Jamesina, learning basic domestic skills such as sweeping and marketing. She eventually met Jonas Blake, a minister and fellow Redmond graduate, falling deeply in love with him and committing to study mathematics to prove her cleverness to him. Despite initial opposition from her mother, Phil remained firm, gained her family's approval, and married Jonas the week after her graduation, with Anne serving as her bridesmaid. Later, she wrote a letter to Gilbert Blythe letting him know Anne was not engaged to Roy Gardner, encouraging him to try again. Prior to Anne's wedding, she visited Green Gables with her husband, and she later innocently sent Anne a congratulatory letter about her newborn, unaware that the infant had tragically died.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053), [v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 c17 P2](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0002), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P2](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0002), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c19 P31](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0031)_
